text:
Nora V.: ran into a weird duplication pattern in the onboarding sampleapp under heavy auth rotations. seems retries align and replay the same create when idempotency isn't supplied.

Tom H.: can you share short repro and logs?

Nora V.: repro (short):
  1) start 5 clients `./loadgen --clients 5 --rate 80 --duration 30s`
  2) flip auth keys via admin API at t=6s (single-step rotate)
  3) observe burst of 429s and near-simultaneous retries, duplicates appear ~2%

Relevant log snippet:
```
WARN 2026-03-30T11:03:12Z retryer: received 429 attempt=1 backoff_ms=20 jitter_ms=0
INFO 2026-03-30T11:03:12Z client: outgoing POST /v1/invoices idemp=(none)
INFO 2026-03-30T11:03:12Z client: retrying attempt=2 backoff_ms=20 jitter_ms=0
ERROR 2026-03-30T11:03:12Z invoice-svc: duplicate detected inv_01bc
```

Lina G.: two angles: (A) SDK parity — auto-generate idempotency if caller omits, (B) randomness/jitter quality — deterministic seeds cause sync.

Tom H.: proposal from my side: "monotonic client id" + adaptive backoff. details:
  - SDK will auto-generate `Idempotency-Key` when missing, format `rdw.<svc>.<clientid>.<mono_counter>` where `clientid` is UUID per process and `mono_counter` increments per attempted side-effect.
  - on each retry attempt increment the mono_counter atomically; attach header `X-Redwood-Idemp-Origin: sdk-auto` when generated.
  - add adaptive backoff that detects auth rotation via server hint `X-Auth-Rotating: true` or 401/429 spikes, and switch jitter to full-jitter plus higher base (start 100ms) for next 10s per-client.
  - expose env `REDWOOD_SDK_IDEMP_STRATEGY=auto|none` and `REDWOOD_SDK_BACKOFF_MODE=adaptive|fixed` for experiments.

Nora V.: I like the client monotonic id because it avoids cross-client collisions when each client keeps its own counter. but need to ensure monotonic counter persists across restarts?

Tom H.: counter is process-local and resets on restart — acceptable for short-lived clients. for long-lived workers we persist last counter in memory; we can add optional disk persistence via `~/.redwood/idemp_state` if teams want resume guarantees.

Lina G.: instrumentation: emit `sdk.idemp.generated`, `sdk.monotonic.counter` and `sdk.backoff.mode` to logs/metrics. also add a server-side header `X-Redwood-Replay-Window-ms` so clients can trim buffered messages older than the window.

SyncBot: CI check triggered: run/retry-harness-seed-99 (will run deterministic seeds for reproducibility).

Tom H.: also a small safety net on server: short-lived soft-dedupe (default 8s) keyed by `Idempotency-Key` when present and by a fingerprint of payload+client-ip when no idemp header. not perfect but reduces duplicates from missing idemp.

Nora V.: can we add a debug-only flag to print `Idempotency-Key` per attempt to stdout for local repro? e.g., `--debug-idemp`

Tom H.: yes will add `--debug-idemp` to loadgen and SDK dev build.

Lina G.: tests: add a CI matrix: backoff modes [adaptive,fixed] x idemp [auto,none] x seeds [99,7,42]. check duplicate_rate <= 0.1%.

Nora V.: thanks. PR incoming for SDK patch and sampleapp changes. will post results after SyncBot CI finishes. :thumbsup:
